name: FLUX.2 Klein 4B (Q4)
description: Black Forest Labs' FLUX.2-klein-4B — the successor to FLUX.1-schnell. A 4-step, CFG-free, 4B-parameter rectified flow transformer with state-of-the-art quality on consumer hardware (~13 GB VRAM, sub-second generation on a single GPU). Drops the FLUX.1 T5+CLIP encoder pair for a single Qwen3-4B LLM encoder. leejet's Q4_0 quantization of the diffusion model paired with Qwen3-4B-Q4_K_M and the FLUX.2-small-decoder VAE. Apache 2.0 throughout — fully commercial-friendly.
